familyTheme: Apply PDDL planning workflows to airport ground-traffic action sequencing tasks under varied operational contexts

derivedTasks.title: Similar - Airport Dispatch Baseline
derivedTasks.goal: Generate valid plans for baseline airport dispatch instances and write each plan to its configured output path.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Requires robust PDDL parsing and plan generation for multiple airport benchmark instances.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Turnaround Wave Scheduling
derivedTasks.goal: Solve a turnaround wave planning pack and emit valid plans at task-specific output paths.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Transfers the same planning primitive to turnaround-wave scheduling framing with different instances.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Ground Crew Shift Handoff
derivedTasks.goal: Produce handoff-ready plan outputs for shift-change planning scenarios.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Transfers PDDL planning into shift-handoff output packaging requirements.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Contingency Reroute Pack
derivedTasks.goal: Create contingency reroute plan files that remain syntactically and semantically valid.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Transfers PDDL planning to contingency reroute scenarios while preserving plan validity constraints.
